children: On August 27, 2026, the company received Nasdaq notices that it failed to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price and the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirements for the Nasdaq Capital Market. Trading continues under SNTI; the company has until Feb 23, 2027 to regain bid-price compliance and must submit an equity compliance plan by Oct 11, 2026.
